SELECT r.room_id AS roomId, r.username1 AS username1, r.username2 AS username2, r.created_at AS createdAt,
m.message AS lastMessage, m.send_time AS lastTime
FROM chat_room r
LEFT JOIN chat_message m ON m.room_id = r.room_id AND m.send_time = ( SELECT MAX(send_time) FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = r.room_id )
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
